youtube.title: ₹500 SIP se Crorepati? Sach Jaano (Step-up Trick) #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kya ₹500 ka SIP aapko crorepati bana sakta hai? Haan, par slow. 12% per year maan kar ₹500 mahina ~45 saal mein ₹1 crore cross karta hai. Har saal SIP 10% badhao, toh kareeb 36 saal mein.
₹500 से शुरू करो, बस ₹500 पर रुको मत।

Is video ke numbers (SIP maths, 12% per year maan kar, sirf example):
• 10 saal: ₹60,000 daale → ~₹1.16 lakh
• 30 saal: ₹1.8 lakh daale → ~₹17.6 lakh
• ₹1 crore: ~45 saal (flat), ~36 saal (10% step-up har saal)
Real returns upar-neeche hote hain, koi guarantee nahi hai.

Aapka SIP kitna hai, aur kab step-up karoge? 👇

📌 Sirf educational content. SEBI-registered nahi. Investment advice nahi.
